type MediaList {
  id: Int!
  userId: Int!
  mediaId: Int!
  status: MediaListStatus
  score(
    format: ScoreFormat
  ): Float
  progress: Int
  progressVolumes: Int
  repeat: Int
  priority: Int
  private: Boolean
  notes: String
  hiddenFromStatusLists: Boolean
  customLists(
    asArray: Boolean
  ): Json
  advancedScores: Json
  startedAt: FuzzyDate
  completedAt: FuzzyDate
  updatedAt: Int
  createdAt: Int
  media: Media
  user: User
}
